events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) engages and disengages with Tolliver (MIN) as the screen is set and does not affect his FOM.
Gasol (MEM) makes contact with Towns' (MIN) face at the start of his drive.
LAR shows Gasol (MEM) reaches in from behind and cleanly deflects the ball away from Towns (MIN).
Gasol (MEM) briefly cups his hand around Towns' (MIN) left arm as the shot is released, but contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.

RLB shows Gibson (MIN) makes slight contact with the back of Gasol's (MEM) head after tipping the ball to a teammate during rebounding. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Towns (MIN) briefly has his hands around Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) midsection before correcting.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) sets the pick on Bayless (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Towns (MIN) hedges the pick and makes marginal body contact with Conley (MEM) that does not affect his SQBR.
Gibson (MIN) sets the screen on Caboclo (MEM) and allows him to move around it after initial contact takes place.
Gasol (MEM) places his hands on Towns' (MIN) hips and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Towns (MIN) legally retrieves the ball in the backcourt after it is deflected by Anderson (MEM).
Correctly called 24 second violation on MIN.
Gasol (MEM) establishes himself in a wide screening position in Bayless' (MIN) path, but contact occurs to Bayless' upper body and does not affect his ability to defend.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) front at the start of his drive and does not affect his SQBR.
Caboclo (MEM) makes marginal contact with Towns' (MIN) body at the start of his drive.
Noah (MEM) briefly engages with Saric (MIN) during the inbound, but disengages without affecting his FOM.
Tolliver (MIN) beats Jackson Jr. (MEM) to the spot and is established in a legal guarding position at the time of the contact.
Wiggins (MIN) makes marginal contact with Conley's (MEM) off-arm after his gather.
Gibson (MIN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
RLB shows Gasol (MEM) holds both of Gibson's (MIN) arms as the shot is released and remains engaged as they each attempt to retrieve the rebound.
Gibson (MIN) and Mack (MEM) engage and disengage with each other during rebounding.
Anderson (MEM) makes contact with Bayless' (MIN) arm during his shooting motion that affects his jump shot attempt.
Caboclo (MEM) and Gibson (MIN) engage with each other as the shot is released, but disengage without affecting the other's ability to retrieve the rebound.
Bayless (MIN) engages with Rabb (MEM) off-ball in the lane, but disengages without affecting his FOM.
Wiggins (MIN) makes marginal contact with Caboclo (MEM) after he receives the pass in the corner.
Wiggins (MIN) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Caboclo (MEM) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact with Anderson (MEM) that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Conley (MEM) makes marginal contact with Bayless (MIN) that does not affect his SQBR.

Bayless (MIN) slightly extends his off-arm against Conley's (MEM) front, but contact is marginal. Additionally, Bayless makes brief contact with his head to Conley's face after his gather. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Gibson (MIN) maintains legal guarding position throughout Gasol's (MEM) drive and then makes incidental "high-five" contact with Gasol after the release of his jump shot attempt.
RLS shows Rabb (MEM) makes marginal contact with Towns' (MIN) right forearm during rebounding.
Towns (MIN) sets the pick on Conley (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Anderson (MEM) releases the inbound pass within five seconds.
Gibson (MIN) makes marginal contact with Gasol (MEM) prior to making clean contact with the ball near the free throw line.
Gasol (MEM) makes inadvertent foot contact with the loose ball in the lane and there is no distinct kicking motion.
Towns (MIN) and Gasol (MEM) both get their hands on the ball attempting to retrieve it and a held ball is correctly called.
Any contact between Gasol (MEM) and Towns (MIN) is marginal and does not affect FOM or SQBR,
Towns (MIN) makes incidental contact with Caboclo (MEM) as they each attempt to gain control of the loose ball.
Caboclo (MEM) and Towns (MIN) both get their hands on the ball attempting to retrieve it and a held ball is correctly called.
Towns (MIN) briefly has his hand against Gasol's (MEM) right shoulder, but does not apply any force or affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a successful field goal attempt by Towns (MIN) prior to the expiration of the game clock is confirmed. For purposes of this review, referees may only review a potential boundary line violation based on the position of the shooter's feet at the moment they last touched the floor immediately prior to (or, if applicable, during) the release of the shot. As noted above, Towns does not step out of bounds and because it was not whistled on the floor, it is not reviewable.
LLB shows that Towns (MIN) avoids stepping out of bounds along the baseline after retrieving the rebound.
